title: Breaking the fast
arabic: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ وَابْتَلَّتِ الْعُرُوقُ، وَثَبَتَ الْأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
translation: The thirst has gone, the veins are moistened, and the reward is certain, if Allah wills.

gradings.in: Sunan al-Daraqutni, Kitab al-Siyam, after hadith 2279 (al-Risala numbering, read on en.tohed.com)
gradings.quote: تَفَرَّدَ بِهِ الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ وَاقِدٍ، وَإِسْنَادُهُ حَسَنٌ

witnesses.name: shamela
witnesses.ref: Sunan Abi Dawud, ed. Muhyi al-Din Abd al-Hamid, hadith 2357: https://shamela.ws/book/1726/3158

usage.evidence: Ibn Umar said that when the Prophet ﷺ broke his fast he said this (Abu Dawud 2357).

variants.label: Also related: "O Allah, for You I fasted, and with Your provision I break my fast." Mursal: Mu'adh ibn Zuhrah relays it from the Prophet ﷺ without naming who told him. Al-Nawawi: "هكذا رواه مرسلا" (al-Adhkar, no. 545).
variants.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ صُمْتُ، وَعَلَى رِزْقِكَ أَفْطَرْتُ
